attchmntText: Pursuant to Regulation 47 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we have enclosed herewith a copy of the newspaper advertisements published in Makkal Kural on November 01, 2026, and in Mint on November 02, 2026.

Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we have enclosed herewith the press release on the Unaudited financial results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

In continuation of our intimation dated September 28, 2026, and pursuant to Regulations 30and 33 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, asamended, we wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company at its meetingheld today, i.e. on October 31, 2026, has inter alia considered and approved:- Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026- Reconstitution of the Risk Management Committee

Pursuant to Regulation 74(5) of SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018, we enclose herewith a copy of the compliance certificate dated October 03, 2026, for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, received from M/s. MUFG Intime India Private Limited (Formerly known as M/s. Link Intime India Private Limited), Registrar and Share Transfer Agent of the Company.
